scripts.leads: wrangler d1 execute maildoc-leads --remote --command "SELECT id, created_at, name, email, company, domain, help_with, vitals_score, spoofable, status FROM leads ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50;"
scripts.leads:new: wrangler d1 execute maildoc-leads --remote --command "SELECT id, created_at, name, email, domain, help_with, message FROM leads WHERE status='new' ORDER BY id DESC;"
scripts.checkups: wrangler d1 execute maildoc-leads --remote --command "SELECT domain, vitals_score, vitals_band, spoofable, checks, last_seen, country FROM checkups ORDER BY vitals_score ASC, last_seen DESC LIMIT 100;"
scripts.checkups:hot: wrangler d1 execute maildoc-leads --remote --command "SELECT domain, vitals_score, spoofable, checks, last_seen FROM checkups WHERE spoofable = 'SPOOFABLE' OR vitals_score < 40 ORDER BY last_seen DESC LIMIT 100;"
